findings.title: Internal platform login is reachable
findings.evidence: Port 8080/tcp redirects to /login and has the title Principal Internal Platform - Login.
findings.remediation: Confirm the platform is only reachable from trusted networks and protected by strong authentication.

findings.title: Proxy-like behavior detected
findings.evidence: The http-open-proxy script reports that the proxy might be redirecting requests.
findings.remediation: Verify the service is not operating as an unintended open proxy and restrict proxy behavior where possible.

findings.title: SSH is exposed
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu.
findings.remediation: Limit SSH access to trusted sources and enforce key-based authentication.

ai_summary.executive: The scan found one Linux host exposing SSH and a Jetty-backed internal platform on port 8080. The web service redirects to a login page and shows proxy-like behavior, so the main concerns are access control, authentication hardening, and confirming it is not usable as an unintended open proxy.
